title: India's leopard count, read properly
caption:
Up overall, down where it hurts.

Madhya Pradesh holds the most leopards (3,907), followed by Maharashtra, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. The survey skipped the high Himalayas and arid areas, so it covers about 70% of leopard habitat.

Source: Status of Leopards in India 2022 (NTCA/WII, released 29 Feb 2024).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
